prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, early 20s goddess, pregnant hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy; a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — but projecting forward from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, its taut round surface distinct from the heavier soft folds that continue below it toward her hips; enormous round hips, gigantic soft thighs pressed together; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, wolf cut platinum silver hair — full body high-gloss glazed celadon porcelain fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid porcelain curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted porcelain sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING pale jade-green celadon glaze across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID fine crackle-glaze lines and delicate incised lotus patterns, with tiny inlaid gemstones set along the joints, high-gloss glazed, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Pose: three-quarter angle, her body turned about forty-five degrees to the camera so the full curve of her round pregnant belly shows in contour, her face turned toward the camera, one hand resting under the curve of her belly and the other relaxed at her side, weight on the back leg, her legs fully in view — most extreme pregnant hourglass SSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Cracks: the celadon porcelain body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left thigh, and one chipped-off piece at her right upper arm, where the broken edge reveals the raw unglazed pale-grey clay with a dull chalky surface inside. Everywhere else, including her bust and her round pregnant belly, the celadon porcelain is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, peep-toe platform stiletto pumps in cream white leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved celadon porcelain right down to the shoes.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, made of the same celadon porcelain with a high polish.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a bold black graphic crease line drawn high above each eyelid, very thick false lashes on the top lids, small painted lash strokes beneath each lower lid, soft lilac-white eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, natural brows, a soft peachy-white lip. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, round pregnant belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved celadon porcelain.

Background: a mirrored cube room with mirrors on all four walls, the ceiling and a glossy black floor, thin hot-pink neon LED strips running along every corner so the pink lines multiply into an endless glowing lattice in all directions, her figure repeated in the lattice from every side, the whole floor clearly visible and in focus, lit by the pink neon and soft light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — carved material everywhere from the collarbones to the ankles. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, so the extreme heel height reads at a glance. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, the reflections being part of that same photograph. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
